DELUXELOCAL SELLS IN PROFITABILITY SPECTACULAR CORNER very close to the SANTIAGO BERNABEU Stadium, (with direct vision over it)
Net Profitability (after expenses) 5%

**LOCATION**
Located in one of the most active areas of Madrid, with many offices and hospitality businesses, a very commercial area, surrounded by hotels and all services. Near the SANTIAGO BERNABEU Stadium, a very commercial area with great influence from the stadium.

**CHARACTERISTICS**:
o The asset has a total area of 45m2 built, 40m2 useful, according to the architect's plan, all distributed on the ground floor
o Toilets: 1
o 9m facade on a CORNER chamfer, with good height
o VERY GOOD VISIBILITY
TENANT:
TOP-LEVEL HOSPITALITY TENANT (without smoke extraction) with several premises in MADRID city
INTEGRAL REFORM

**Economic Data***
Price-828,000+VAT (company sells, VAT self-assessed)
Net profitability-5% (after community fees and IBI)
Deposit + additional guarantees (total 6 months)
10-year contract with MANDATORY COMPLIANCE of 3 years
IPC increases and extraordinary increases IPC+3% 6th year and 11th year
Sales consultancy fees: 1.5%+VAT of the sale price on the buyer's side.

Perfect as an investment!
Location, location and location.. .
